inpost.title: Add an InPost account
inpost.description: An SMS code will be sent to this number.

dpd.title: Add a DPD account
dpd.description: An SMS code will be sent to this number (DPD Mobile).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The session for {phone} expired. Send a new SMS code to sign in again.

fedex.title: Add a FedEx account
fedex.description: Official FedEx developer.fedex.com API — Client ID/Secret from a project in your FedEx developer organization, not a phone number. Add tracking numbers afterwards in Options.

pocztex.title: Add a Pocztex account
pocztex.description: Pocztex Mobile login — email and password of an existing account (registration is app-only, this can't create one). Auto-discovers every parcel tied to the account, like DPD.

dhl.title: Add a DHL account
dhl.description: An SMS code will be sent to this number (Mój DHL).

orlen.title: Add Orlen Paczka tracking
orlen.description: Public track-by-number — no account or API key. Add parcel numbers afterwards in Options.

orlen_account.title: Add Orlen Paczka (account)
orlen_account.description: Logs into the ORLEN Paczka app by phone number — an SMS code confirms it, then every parcel addressed to that number is tracked automatically. The integration does not ship the app credentials: enter the ORLEN Paczka app client secret (Entra ID) yourself, see the README.

allegro_one.title: Add Allegro One tracking
allegro_one.description: Public track-by-number via Allegro edge API — no OAuth. Use Allegro-internal waybills (A… / AD…), not UPS/DPD/Orlen subcontractor numbers. Add numbers afterwards in Options.

orlen_account_reauth.title: Orlen Paczka: log in again
orlen_account_reauth.description: Confirm or enter the ORLEN Paczka app client secret; an SMS code is then sent to {phone}.

error.invalid_phone: The phone number must be exactly 9 digits.
error.sms_rejected: The carrier did not accept this number.
error.invalid_client_secret: The sign-in server rejected the ORLEN Paczka app client secret.

data.tracking_numbers_csv: Tracking numbers, comma-separated (FedEx / Orlen Paczka / Allegro One)
data.ignored_shipments_csv: Ignored shipment numbers, comma-separated (InPost only) — hides zombie records InPost's own app no longer shows
